HOST_TOKEN.description: The password your phone uses to connect to this relay. Any random string of 16 or more characters. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 24` and keep it private: you paste it into the Zonk-Core app later.

API_KEY.description: The password people use to chat through a private relay. Any random string of 16 or more characters, different from HOST_TOKEN. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 24`. A public relay does not ask for it, but fill it in anyway.
